title: Assistant Manager- Manufacturing Engineering
description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :**
 Develop and industrialize
 **new and advanced manufacturing processes** 
 , including low\-cost automation solutions.
   

  

 Lead/support
 **installation, commissioning, debugging, validation, and troubleshooting** 
 of automated and special\-purpose equipment.
   

  

 Develop process specifications, tooling, fixtures, tool charts, work standards, and engineering documentation.
   

  

 Design and develop
 **tooling, fixtures, prototypes, and equipment concepts** 
 for new and existing processes.
   

  

 Support
 **APQP and new product launches** 
 , ensuring process and equipment readiness before SOP and production ramp\-up.
   

  

 Develop and maintain
 **PFMEA, Control Plans, process standards** 
 , and other manufacturing documentation.
   

  

 Ensure effective application of
 **ISO/TS 16949 / IATF 16949 requirements and Automotive Core Tools, including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Control Plan** 
 , during process development, industrialization, validation, and production launch.
   

  

 Drive improvements in
 **productivity, cycle time, quality, OEE, capacity, equipment reliability, and manufacturing cost** 
 .
   

  

 Analyze process and test data, conduct manufacturing trials, and implement sustainable corrective and improvement actions.
   

  

 Support
 **robotics, PLC\-controlled equipment, sensors, instrumentation, vision/measurement systems, and machine automation** 
 .
   

  

 Prepare equipment specifications, support
 **capital expenditure proposals** 
 , and execute equipment development and industrialization projects.
   

  

 Work closely with
 **Product Engineering, Quality, Production, Maintenance, suppliers, and global cross\-functional teams** 
 .
   

  

 Promote manufacturing
 **best practices, process standardization, technical knowledge\-sharing** 
 , and mentor junior engineers.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of relevant manufacturing/industrialization experience, preferably within the automotive industry.
* Hands\-on experience with automated assembly equipment, special\-purpose machines, robotics, PLCs, and industrial automation.
* Experience in non\-standard equipment design, development, commissioning, or debugging is preferred.
* Experience in tooling, fixture design, equipment installation, process validation, and production ramp\-up.


 Knowledge \& Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in CAD/3D design software such as Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of PLC systems, industrial instrumentation, sensors, robotics, machine controls, and automation systems.
* Knowledge of LabVIEW or similar data acquisition/test systems is an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of ISO/TS 16949 / IATF 16949 requirements.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Automotive Core Tools, including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Control Plan.
* Knowledge of DOE, Six Sigma, structured problem\-solving, and continuous improvement methodologies is preferred.
* Strong hands\-on troubleshooting, analytical, problem\-solving, and project\-management skills.
* Good English communication skills with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional, supplier, and global teams.
